_doc: Director copy (tt-01, owner request 2026-10-25): tooltips are one short plain sentence that says what a term does; edge cases and rule details move to the Grimoire. 'tooltip' replaces the glossary definition. Terms not listed keep their text: every skill_* entry (skills are rules text) and the six battlefield rules (wildfire, frostbite, lightning_storm, upheaval, shadowstep, wind is rewritten).

panel_rules.note: Time is on every card; its panel is dropped from card focus tooltips only. The glossary entry stays for other surfaces (turn clock, Grimoire).

grimoire_rule: For every changed term, the Grimoire keeps the old full definition: append it to the existing keyword/combat/basics entry for that id if its text is not already there, or create a keywords entry (title = name, icon = glossary icon, body = [old definition]) following the existing entry schema and discovery rules.

entries.name: Reflect
entries.old: Single-target ranged hits from more than 1 tile away bounce back to the attacker. Melee, area and Chain hits land.
entries.tooltip: Ranged hits from 2+ tiles away bounce back to the attacker.

entries.name: Dive
entries.old: Flies straight at you, giving each unit it passes Push 1 to its right. Strikes if it lands beside you.
entries.tooltip: Flies straight at you and strikes if it lands beside you.

entries.name: Flying
entries.old: Ignores traps, ground and Collision damage. Push, Pull and Gust still move it.
entries.tooltip: Ignores traps, ground and Collision damage.

entries.name: Lob Slag
entries.old: Marks your tile and the 4 around it. On its next turn, they take the shown damage and become Fire.
entries.tooltip: Marks your tile and the 4 around it; next turn they take damage and become Fire.

entries.name: Charge
entries.old: Gains Charge each use. At 3, its next intent is Arc Burst: lightning jumping between nearby units. Shock removes 1.
entries.tooltip: At 3 Charge it unleashes Arc Burst. Shock removes 1.

entries.name: Mirror
entries.old: Copies your last damaging card at base damage, without its effects. The copy is fixed when declared.
entries.tooltip: Copies your last damaging card's base damage.

entries.name: Icefall
entries.old: Marks 3 tiles across your tile. Next turn they take the shown damage and turn to Ice.
entries.tooltip: Marks 3 tiles that take damage and turn to Ice next turn.

entries.name: Gust
entries.old: On its beat, the wind Pushes every unit downwind. Anchored units don't move.
entries.tooltip: On its beat, the wind pushes every unit downwind.

entries.name: Veiled
entries.old: You can target it only from an adjacent tile. Untargeted hits, like Area Attacks and Chain, still land.
entries.tooltip: Can only be targeted from an adjacent tile.

entries.name: Burrow
entries.old: Burrows and marks your tile; Erupt comes next. Burrowed, it can't be targeted or moved, but Area Attacks hit it.
entries.tooltip: Burrows under your tile, then erupts there next.

entries.name: Erupt
entries.old: Emerges at the mark, hitting and displacing its occupant. Neighbors get Push 1. Leaves Rubble; gains Expose 2.
entries.tooltip: Bursts up at the mark, hitting whoever stands there.

entries.name: Bursts
entries.old: When it dies, it deals the shown damage to every unit in the 8 tiles around it, then leaves Fire.
entries.tooltip: When it dies, it hits every unit next to it and leaves Fire.

entries.name: Shape Ground
entries.old: Place the shown ground on the shown tiles. A tile holds Rubble plus one other ground.
entries.tooltip: Place the shown ground on the shown tiles.

entries.name: Fire
entries.old: A unit that enters takes 2 damage. One that starts its turn here takes 3.
entries.tooltip: Entering deals 2 damage; starting a turn here deals 3.

entries.name: Ice
entries.old: A unit that enters or starts its turn here is Chilled until it leaves.
entries.tooltip: Units on it are Chilled.

entries.name: Electrified
entries.old: A Lightning hit that touches it spreads to every foe on connected Electrified tiles. Chain relays through it.
entries.tooltip: Lightning hits spread across connected Electrified tiles.

entries.name: Chilled
entries.old: Takes 2 more damage from attacks. An Ice attack Freezes it and Expends the Ice beneath.
entries.tooltip: Takes 2 more damage from attacks; an Ice attack Freezes it.

entries.name: Detonate
entries.old: Expend the chosen Fire, or the shown ground. Hit everyone on those tiles and next to them once, including you.
entries.tooltip: Blow up the chosen ground, hitting everyone on and next to it, you included.

entries.name: Expend
entries.old: Remove the shown ground from its tile to power the listed effect.
entries.tooltip: Remove the shown ground to power this effect.

entries.name: Relocate Ground
entries.old: Move one ground tile to another open tile.
entries.tooltip: Move a ground tile to another open tile.

entries.name: Melee
entries.old: Deal that much damage to an adjacent target, or one within the shown Range.
entries.tooltip: Damage an adjacent target, or one within the shown Range.

entries.name: Ranged
entries.old: Deal that much damage to a target within Range and line of sight.
entries.tooltip: Damage a target in Range and line of sight.

entries.name: Pierce
entries.old: This damage ignores Block and Stoneskin.
entries.tooltip: Ignores Block and Stoneskin.

entries.name: Move
entries.old: Walk up to that many tiles around obstacles, triggering ground and traps you enter. Pick your own tile to stay.
entries.tooltip: Walk up to that many tiles.

entries.name: Blink
entries.old: Teleport to a visible open tile within that many tiles, ignoring anything between. Pick your own tile to stay.
entries.tooltip: Teleport up to that many tiles to a visible open tile.

entries.name: Range
entries.old: Maximum distance in tiles, counted without diagonals.
entries.tooltip: Maximum distance in tiles.

entries.name: Block
entries.old: Absorbs damage before Health. Lost at the start of its holder's next turn.
entries.tooltip: Absorbs damage until its holder's next turn.

entries.name: Stoneskin
entries.old: Absorbs damage after Block. Lasts until used up or combat ends.
entries.tooltip: Absorbs damage after Block; lasts until used up.

entries.name: Heal
entries.old: Restore that much Health, up to the maximum.
entries.tooltip: Restore that much Health.

entries.name: Draw
entries.old: Draw that many cards. Your hand holds at most 7.
entries.tooltip: Draw that many cards.

entries.name: Card Play
entries.old: Playing a card spends 1. Refills each turn. Killing an enemy on your turn grants 1 more, except summons.
entries.tooltip: Playing a card spends one. Refills each turn; kills give one more.

entries.name: Flurry
entries.old: Repeat this card once per Card Play left, spending them all, on the same target. Pay its Time once.
entries.tooltip: Repeat this card once per Card Play left, spending them all.

entries.name: Follow-up
entries.old: If you already played a card this turn: gain the listed bonus.
entries.tooltip: Gain the bonus if you already played a card this turn.

entries.name: Empower
entries.old: Pay the extra cost as you play this card to gain its bonus. Charge it with the card's seal.
entries.tooltip: Pay the extra cost as you play this card to gain its bonus.

entries.name: Stagger
entries.old: Delays the target's next turn by this much Time. Dragons take half. At most 6 per enemy each turn.
entries.tooltip: Delays the target's next turn by this much Time.

entries.name: Time
entries.old: Cards cost Time; the more you spend, the later your next turn. Playing under 2 cards adds Wait.
entries.tooltip: Spending Time makes your next turn come later.

entries.name: Illusion
entries.old: Create a decoy with that much Health. Enemies attack it when it's at least as close as you.
entries.tooltip: A decoy with that much Health; enemies attack it if it's as close as you.

entries.name: Light
entries.old: Reveals tiles within its radius through the Umbra for the shown number of your turns.
entries.tooltip: Lights tiles within its radius through the Umbra.

entries.name: Vision
entries.old: Widen your sight radius by that much for the shown turns. It creates no Light.
entries.tooltip: See that many tiles farther for the shown turns.

entries.name: Truesight
entries.old: For the shown turns, every enemy counts as visible: you see its intent and can target it.
entries.tooltip: Every enemy counts as visible for the shown turns.

entries.name: Dispel Umbra
entries.old: Lower the Umbra by that many stages for the rest of this combat.
entries.tooltip: Lower the Umbra by that many stages this combat.

entries.name: Eclipse
entries.old: The darkest Umbra stage: you see only 1 tile around you. Light still reveals; Dispel Umbra lowers it.
entries.tooltip: The darkest Umbra: you see only 1 tile around you.

entries.name: Bleed
entries.old: Before each move or attack, it takes damage equal to its Bleed. Clears when its turn ends.
entries.tooltip: Takes that much damage before each move or attack.

entries.name: Expose
entries.old: The next attack that damages it deals that much more damage. Then Expose ends.
entries.tooltip: Its next damaging hit takes that much more damage.

entries.name: Sunder
entries.old: Before damage, remove up to that much Block, then Stoneskin, from the target.
entries.tooltip: Strips that much Block, then Stoneskin, before damage.

entries.name: Exhaust
entries.old: After use, this card leaves your deck until combat ends.
entries.tooltip: Leaves your deck for the rest of combat.

entries.name: Consume
entries.old: After use, this item is gone for the rest of the run.
entries.tooltip: Gone for the rest of the run once used.

entries.name: Retaliate
entries.old: Until your next turn, each enemy that hits you up close takes that much damage and the listed effects.
entries.tooltip: Until your next turn, enemies that hit you up close take that much damage.

entries.name: Quicken
entries.old: Your next card this turn costs that much less Time, minimum 1. Unused Quicken ends with your turn.
entries.tooltip: Your next card this turn costs that much less Time.

entries.name: Rite
entries.old: Its effect lasts for the rest of this combat. Exhaust.
entries.tooltip: Lasts the rest of combat. Exhaust.

entries.name: Next Attack
entries.old: Your next attack on a later card this turn gets the shown bonus. Unused bonuses end with your turn.
entries.tooltip: Your next attack this turn gains the bonus.

entries.name: Swap
entries.old: Trade places with a visible one-tile enemy or your illusion. Both trigger the ground where they land.
entries.tooltip: Trade places with a visible enemy or your illusion.

entries.name: Petrify
entries.old: Skips its next turn, still paying its Time, and gains 5 Block through your next turn. Dragons are immune.
entries.tooltip: Skips its next turn and gains 5 Block.

entries.name: Skate
entries.old: This turn, stepping onto Ice costs no movement, and Ice doesn't make you Chilled.
entries.tooltip: This turn, Ice costs no movement and doesn't Chill you.

entries.name: Anchored
entries.old: Push, Pull and Wind don't move it or cause a Collision. Yours lasts until your next turn.
entries.tooltip: Push, Pull and Wind can't move it.

entries.name: Fireproof
entries.old: This turn, Fire ground doesn't damage you.
entries.tooltip: This turn, Fire ground doesn't hurt you.

entries.name: Convert Ground
entries.old: Turn the chosen ground tile, and its connected tiles when shown, into another ground. Hit each enemy on them.
entries.tooltip: Turn the chosen ground into another kind, hitting enemies on it.

entries.name: Discharge
entries.old: Remove a connected Electrified network. Hit each enemy on it or next to it once.
entries.tooltip: Remove a connected Electrified network, hitting enemies on and next to it.

entries.name: Sweeping Strike
entries.old: Hit every enemy you can see that meets the shown condition, within Range if shown. No target to choose.
entries.tooltip: Hits every visible enemy that qualifies; no target needed.

entries.name: Swap Illusion
entries.old: Swap with one of your visible illusions, anywhere unless a Range is shown.
entries.tooltip: Swap places with one of your illusions.

entries.name: Shatter Illusion
entries.old: Destroy one of your illusions in range. Hit each enemy next to it.
entries.tooltip: Destroy one of your illusions, hitting enemies next to it.

entries.name: Freeze
entries.old: Skips its next turn. Takes triple damage from attacks until then.
entries.tooltip: Skips its next turn and takes triple damage until then.

entries.name: Chain
entries.old: Jump to a new target within that many tiles, repeating from each one. Electrified tiles relay the jump.
entries.tooltip: Jumps to new targets within that many tiles of each hit.

entries.name: Push
entries.old: Move the target that many tiles straight away from the source. If blocked: Collision.
entries.tooltip: Move the target that many tiles straight away; if blocked, Collision.

entries.name: Pull
entries.old: Move the target that many tiles straight toward the source. If blocked before reaching it: Collision.
entries.tooltip: Move the target that many tiles straight closer; if blocked, Collision.

entries.name: Collision
entries.old: A stopped Push or Pull deals 2 damage per lost tile to the target and to its blocker.
entries.tooltip: A blocked Push or Pull deals 2 damage per tile left, to both units.

entries.name: Health
entries.old: At 0 Health a unit is defeated or terrain breaks. Your Health carries over between rooms.
entries.tooltip: At 0 Health, a unit is defeated.

entries.name: Health Cost
entries.old: Lose that much Health when the card finishes. Block and Stoneskin don't prevent it.
entries.tooltip: Lose that much Health; Block can't prevent it.

entries.name: Area Attack
entries.old: Hits each foe on the pattern's red tiles, seen or unseen.
entries.tooltip: Hits every foe on the red tiles, even unseen ones.

entries.name: Lightning Strikes
entries.old: Strikes the marked tiles for the shown damage, then turns them Electrified, replacing its old field.
entries.tooltip: Strikes the marked tiles, then leaves them Electrified.

entries.name: Summon
entries.old: Calls the shown enemy, up to a limit of living ones. Killing a summon grants no Card Play.
entries.tooltip: Calls the shown enemy into the fight. When an enemy summons, you gain +1 Card Play on your next turn.
entries.decision: sum-01: director-approved summon reward copy (int-06 integration repair).

entries.name: Raise Terrain
entries.old: Raises attackable terrain with the shown Health. It blocks movement; some kinds also block sight.
entries.tooltip: Raises terrain that blocks movement.

entries.name: Terrain Burst
entries.old: Hits units around terrain pieces for the shown damage. Some uses destroy the terrain too.
entries.tooltip: Hits units around its terrain pieces.

entries.name: Cinder Marks
entries.old: Marks the shown tiles. When it lands, they take the shown damage and become Fire.
entries.tooltip: Marks tiles that take damage and turn to Fire when it lands.

entries.name: Crownfire
entries.old: Detonate the Fire on its last Cinder Marks. Everyone caught is hit once, the dragon included.
entries.tooltip: Detonates the Fire on its last Cinder Marks, hitting everyone caught.

entries.name: Hollow Gale
entries.old: Strikes everywhere within 2 tiles of the dragon with Push 2, then erupts along its last Razor Dive path.
entries.tooltip: Strikes everywhere within 2 tiles of Vaeloryx and Pushes struck actors 1 tile.
entries.decision: bos-02: director-approved Hollow Gale copy after removing the Dive wake and retaining own Push 1 (feedback 2).

entries.name: Crystal Mantle
entries.old: Each layer cancels 1 direct hit, then breaks. Ground damage, Bleed, Collision and traps bypass it.
entries.tooltip: Each layer cancels one direct hit.

entries.name: Guard Ally
entries.old: Gives the shown Block to one or more enemies, sometimes including itself.
entries.tooltip: Gives Block to its allies, sometimes itself.

entries.name: Heal Ally
entries.old: Restores the shown Health to a wounded enemy, possibly itself.
entries.tooltip: Heals a wounded enemy, possibly itself.

entries.name: Last Eclipse
entries.old: Unprotected targets take the shown damage, then the Umbra becomes Eclipse for 2 turns. Light, Vision and Truesight protect you.
entries.tooltip: Hits anyone outside Light, then plunges the room into Eclipse.

entries.name: Radiance
entries.old: Cards and skills that counter the Umbra with Light, Vision, Truesight and Dispel Umbra.
entries.tooltip: Cards that push back the Umbra.

entries.name: Embers
entries.old: Earned from kills and victories. Spend them on wares and levels. Dying drops them; recover them next run.
entries.tooltip: Spent on wares and levels; dropped when you die.

entries.name: The Run
entries.old: One attempt through 6 sections, each ending in a dragon. Ends at the last dragon, at defeat or by Embrace.
entries.tooltip: One journey through 6 sections, each ending in a dragon.

entries.name: Map and Rooms
entries.old: Each section is a map of rooms. Pick a forward route through combat, Relic, Scavenger, Ember Hearth and other rooms.
entries.tooltip: Choose your route through the section's rooms.

entries.name: Character
entries.old: The menu for your gear, magic, items and skills. Gear, magic and items form your deck.
entries.tooltip: Your gear, magic, items and skills.

entries.name: Rewards
entries.old: After a combat, choose 1 of 3 magic cards, or skip to heal 3. Dragons and Guardians also give relics.
entries.tooltip: After combat, take 1 of 3 cards, or skip to heal 3.

entries.name: Relics
entries.old: Passive effects that last the whole run. Found in Relic rooms and won from dragons and Guardians.
entries.tooltip: Passive effects that last the whole run.

entries.name: Combat Board
entries.old: The 9×9 tile grid where combat happens.
entries.tooltip: The 9×9 grid where combat happens.

entries.name: Turn Clock
entries.old: Each unit has a next-turn time; the lowest acts next, and you win ties. Spending Time pushes yours later.
entries.tooltip: The unit with the lowest Time acts next; you win ties.

entries.name: Health and Defenses
entries.old: Damage hits Block first, then Stoneskin, then Health. Pierce skips Block and Stoneskin.
entries.tooltip: Damage hits Block, then Stoneskin, then Health.

entries.name: Defiance
entries.old: Each charge turns lethal damage into 25% Health. You get 1 per 4 levels, refilled each run.
entries.tooltip: Each charge turns a lethal hit into 25% Health.

entries.name: Targeting
entries.old: Targets must be visible and within Range. Ranged attacks also need line of sight; walls and outcrops block it.
entries.tooltip: Targets must be visible and in Range; ranged attacks need line of sight.

entries.name: Fatigue
entries.old: When you must draw from an empty draw pile, reshuffle your discard and lose 2 Health, +1 each time.
entries.tooltip: Drawing from an empty pile reshuffles your discard and costs Health.

entries.name: Traps
entries.old: Trigger once when entered or hit. They damage their tile and spread their element to the 4 tiles around.
entries.tooltip: Trigger when entered or hit, spreading their element around.

entries.name: The Umbra
entries.old: Darkness that limits your sight. Hidden enemies show no intent and can't be targeted, but Area Attacks still hit them.
entries.tooltip: Darkness that hides enemies and their intents.

entries.name: Worldspines
entries.old: Attackable stone spires that block movement, not sight. Destroyed ones leave Rubble. Damage pulses out around them.
entries.tooltip: Stone spires that block movement but not sight.

entries.name: Fire
entries.old: Card element. Fire cards mostly place Fire ground and Detonate it.
entries.tooltip: Fire cards place Fire ground and Detonate it.

entries.name: Ice
entries.old: Card element. Ice cards place Ice ground, and an Ice attack Freezes a Chilled target.
entries.tooltip: Ice cards place Ice and Freeze Chilled targets.

entries.name: Lightning
entries.old: Card element. Lightning cards place Electrified ground; a damaging Lightning attack spreads through it.
entries.tooltip: Lightning cards place Electrified ground and spread through it.

entries.name: Air
entries.old: Card element. Air cards move units with Push and Pull, and move you.
entries.tooltip: Air cards push, pull and move units.

entries.name: Earth
entries.old: Card element. Earth cards leave Rubble, raise terrain and grant Stoneskin.
entries.tooltip: Earth cards leave Rubble, raise terrain and grant Stoneskin.

entries.name: Skill Point
entries.old: Earned as you level up. Spend them on skills in the Character menu.
entries.tooltip: Earned by leveling; spend them on skills.

entries.name: Moltshards
entries.old: Won from your first dragon each run. Trade 1 for 250 Embers, or spend 1 to reset your skills.
entries.tooltip: Won from your first dragon; trade for Embers or reset your skills.

entries.name: Wait
entries.old: Each of your first 2 Card Plays left unused adds 5 Time to your next turn.
entries.tooltip: Each of your first 2 unused Card Plays adds 5 Time to your next turn.

entries.name: Turns
entries.old: Counts down at the start of each of your turns. The effect ends at 0; ∞ lasts all combat.
entries.tooltip: How many of your turns this effect lasts.

entries.name: Movement
entries.old: Tiles you can walk each turn without a card or Time. Refills at the start of your turn; base 2.
entries.tooltip: Tiles you can walk each turn for free.

entries.name: Item
entries.old: A card equipped in one of your 2 item slots. It joins your deck and has Consume.
entries.tooltip: A one-use card from your item slots.

entries.name: Outcrop
entries.old: Attackable terrain that blocks movement. Worldspines and Powder Kegs count as Outcrops. Plain ones also block sight and leave Rubble.
entries.tooltip: Attackable terrain that blocks movement.
